findings.claim: v2 sets readOnlyHint only on ctx_search/ctx_resume/ctx_stats and says nothing about annotations on the other tools. Codex cancels MCP tool calls whose descriptors lack annotations (#846). v1 fixed this by giving every ctx_* tool explicit annotations. v2 text can re-break it for ctx_execute, ctx_batch, ctx_index, ctx_doctor, ctx_upgrade, ctx_purge.
findings.evidence: PRD-v2.md:120 '`readOnlyHint: true` on `ctx_search`, `ctx_resume`, `ctx_stats`'; PRD E10 (line 164). git show ff5b0cff: 'Codex cancels unannotated tool calls before execution ("user cancelled MCP tool call"), so read-only tools like ctx_stats and ctx_doctor never ran'. #846 is absent from ISSUE-OUTCOMES-r2.md (grep count 0).
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: ff5b0cff 2026-06-22 'fix(codex): MCP sentinel namespace + PreToolUse rewrites + tool annotations (#844 #845 #846) (#851)'. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: all 9 tools carry readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, openWorldHint; ctx_doctor is read-only; test inspects registered descriptors, not text.

findings.claim: The hook matcher list is Claude Code names only (Bash|PowerShell|Read|Grep|WebFetch). Codex sends its own tool names (local_shell, shell, shell_command, exec_command, apply_patch, grep_files). §15.3 says Codex PreToolUse is 'same'. No doc lists the Codex native names, the input field that holds the command, or the updatedInput shape for each name. A Claude-name matcher on Codex either misses calls or relies on aliases that no doc verifies.

findings.claim: ADR-0016 finds a subagent's tools by reading .claude/agents/<type>.md. That is Claude Code only. Codex hooks also carry agent_id and agent_type for subagent calls, but Codex custom agents are not in .claude/agents. The ADR gives Codex a 'yes' for case A with no way to know whether a Codex subagent has ctx tools, so the MUST of ADR-0016 has no mechanism on Codex.
findings.evidence: ADR-0016:18-20; ADR-0016:41 'Codex, Gemini, Qwen | yes | rewrite supported'. codex-rs/hooks/src/schema.rs:70-80 SubagentCommandInputFields {agent_id, agent_type}; events/pre_tool_use.rs:180-181 and post_tool_use.rs:155-156 pass them to the hook.
findings.fix: Add a per-agent 'subagent tool source' column to the ADR-0016 table (Codex: where agent definitions live, or fixed row from a live check). Add an LV check for Codex: subagent with shell only runs a 5 MB command.

findings.claim: Codex case C says 'replace only as a reason/error text; the selected chunks go in that text'. In the Codex hooks crate, PostToolUse decision:block only sets should_block and adds the reason as feedback; nothing shows that the original tool output is removed from the model context. Also PostToolUse additionalContext is cut by Codex to a head/tail preview above 2,500 tokens (default), which is truncation the owner forbids, and v1 records that Codex PostToolUse does not fire on failing Bash calls (#300).
findings.evidence: codex-rs/hooks/src/events/post_tool_use.rs:123-139 (should_block, feedback_message), test 'block_decision_stops_normal_processing' :353; output_spill.rs:12 'DEFAULT_HOOK_OUTPUT_TOKEN_LIMIT: usize = 2_500' and :54-58 'replaced with the same head/tail preview'; v1 src/adapters/codex/hooks.ts:21-22 'updatedMCPToolOutput parsed but logged as unsupported' / 'PostToolUse does not fire on failing Bash calls'.
